messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Elevated 5xx rate detected for service=\"inference-gateway\" (edge -> lb). 5xx% 12.4 over 1m, latency p95 > 1.2s. Auto-paged oncall. Link: https://ops.redwood/investigate/3312223333

jamie_ops: oncall Jamie here, ack. I see the pager. Triage in progress.

sara_sre: initial datapoints: LB 10.3.21.45 -> upstream cluster 'model-shard-a' showing majority 503/502. Envoy admin shows a ton of upstream resets and retries.

monica_runtime: I'm seeing an odd header rewrite pattern in the logs — requests come in with x-rw-session, then we rewrite to X-Forwarded-Host and it gets routed back to the gateway, creating an opaque loop. Could be a route rewrite + external proxy combo.

kevin_prod_support: quick customer impact note: a handful of high-traffic customers reported chat timeouts and half of sessions retrying. CS got ~8 tickets in the last 20m.

jamie_ops: grabbing cluster/route state. Running admin checks on LB and envoy configs.

jamie_ops: run: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9901/clusters?format=json | jq '.clusters[] | select(.name|test("model-shard-a"))'`

jamie_ops: logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] envoy: upstream reset: connection termination
[2026-03-15T14:12:04Z] envoy: retried request: 3 attempts reached
[2026-03-15T14:12:05Z] proxy: request loop detected: repeated header X-Forwarded-Host
```

sara_sre: Confirmed: route has `retry_policy` enabled with `num_retries: 2` and `per_try_timeout: 2s`. Because of the header loop, retries are amplifying load and tripping circuit breakers downstream.

monica_runtime: Two immediate mitigations I propose (fast):
- disable retries at LB route level (prevent amplification)
- set route weight 0 for `inference-candidates` path to drain traffic to fallback pool

jamie_ops: Agreed. I'll disable retries first. Applying quick hotpatch to route config (local patch):
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-route-overrides -p '{"data":{"retry_policy":"none"}}'
# or via router control-plane: apply override with retry_policy: none
```

deploy-bot: Hotpatch queued. Applying to edge pool-1 -> started.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied at 3312223370. Config change id: cfg-98123.

monica_runtime: While retries were disabled, I'll also patch header rewrite rule to stop forwarding X-Forwarded-Host from the gateway back to the edge. Patch snippet:
```
# remove problematic rewrite
spec:
  routes:
    - name: "/v1/chat"
      request_headers_to_remove: ["x-forwarded-host"]
```

jamie_ops: Applying header rewrite removal to canary (edge pool-1, shard-a). Command: `kubectl -n infra apply -f envoy-rewrite-fix-canary.yaml`

monica_runtime: Also bumped circuit-breaker max_connections up slightly for model-shard-a so current inflight errors don't cascade: `max_connections: 12000 -> 20000` (temp)

sara_sre: Monitoring dashboards... 5xx starting to drop — currently 5xx% 3.1 (was 12.4). p95 latency trending down.

kevin_prod_support: Noted - CS: reduced incoming tickets, customers reporting degraded -> recovered states in some sessions. Logging updates to customers.

jamie_ops: Rolling the header rewrite change to the rest of edge pools if metrics hold. If anything spikes revert weight changes.

deploy-bot: rollout to edge pools in progress: pool-2 -> pool-3. All applied by 3312223385.

monica_runtime: Quick verification of the loop: grep in access logs shows inbound Host header 'gateway.internal' then we were adding X-Forwarded-Host 'gateway.internal' which matched a route with host rewrite back to gateway. Removing that rewrite stops the cycle.

sara_sre: Final numbers: 5xx% now 0.9 over 5m, retries suppressed. No further customer-impact alerts in last 3m.

jamie_ops: Good work. Creating follow-up ticket for root-cause investigation: `INC-2026-33122` -> action items: audit all header rewrites, add guard to prevent route->gateway host matches, add test for retry amplification in staging.

kevin_prod_support: I'll coordinate changelog and customer comms. Recommend a brief status update to affected customers.

monica_runtime: Postmortem candidate. I'll own the RC investigation. Leaving handover to oncall rotation in 30m.

incident-bot: Incident declared mitigated at 3312223399. Metrics will be monitored for 1h.

jamie_ops: ACK. Moving to watch state. Thanks all :thumbsup:
